meta_description:
10K likes, 3,413 comments - halfbakedharvest on October 25, 2026: "Red Wine Braised Pot Roast - Comment HBH to get the recipe straight to your DM’s or inbox!

Nothing is more delicious, or more comforting as we head into November and the holiday season! It’s my classic beef pot roast braised in red wine with onions, carrots, and fresh thyme. Do not skip the creamy mashed potatoes. I cook the potatoes with the pot roast, then mash. They’re super easy and so good. 

https://www.halfbakedharvest.com/red-wine-braised-pot-roast/".
